cells.I: Authenticated resident endpoint. SUBMIT_PAYMENT creates a signed upload URL and document reference but does not change the payment status until CONFIRM_RECEIPT_UPLOAD verifies the stored object. residentId must match the JWT user. Receipt upload completion: After migration 20261118100000_receipt_upload_payment_review.sql is applied, a nonempty receipt uploaded to society-documents automatically changes its linked UNPAID payment to UNDER REVIEW, including facility bookings. Creating an upload URL alone does not change status. CONFIRM_RECEIPT_UPLOAD remains supported. Re-fetch the payment list after upload completion; UNDER REVIEW means approval pending and the app should suppress Pay Now. Existing unpaid records with stored receipts are repaired by the migration; paid and rejected historical records are preserved. A new receipt upload may resubmit a rejected payment. Deployed 2026-11-18 to isrqhkshygauaehwfycw. Migration recorded and storage trigger enabled. Live database trigger regression passed with all fixture writes rolled back. Existing payments repaired: 0. Live HTTP regression passed using a disposable resident: SUBMIT_PAYMENT, raw-byte PUT to uploadUrl (HTTP 200), automatic UNDER REVIEW without confirmation, FETCH_OWN signed proof URL, and byte-identical image download. All disposable storage, payment, auth, resident, and contact fixtures removed. App UI not tested; reported booking proof file remains absent from Storage.
